label: Trusted sources & approval
summary: A clear dated trusted-source report counts as verified reporting unless later corrected or revoked by trusted reporting. Russian-origin reopening claims remain explicitly unverified claims.

approval_routes.trusted_reporting: One clear dated report from a listed trusted source is sufficient for its facility/event/town assertions unless a later trusted-source correction or revocation invalidates them. No second source or independent claim fact-check is required. Preserve who made a quoted claim; do not expand the report into unstated damage, closure, precise location or present operation. Russian-origin reopening/running claims use the separate claim route below.
approval_routes.first_party: Readable dated operator, emergency-service or local-authority statements can support their own facility/event facts. Russian government/operator assertions of reopening or running are displayed as Russian claims, not verified operational recovery.
approval_routes.matched_media: An actual AI visual review may approve the basic incident when available photos/videos coherently establish the same identifiable facility in the town and the event date/context is supported. Record source links, specific matching observations and timing evidence; another publisher is not mandatory. Shared footage or duplicate reposts are one evidence chain.
approval_routes.russian_reopening_claim: Keep Russian government, authority or operator assertions of restored/continued operation explicitly unverified with origin russia and a 🇷🇺 claim label, including when repeated by a trusted outlet. Record date, actor and source; preserve prior dated supported status. A trusted outlet’s own independently reported operating finding is distinct from merely quoting that assertion.

holds: Later trusted-source correction/revocation or an unresolved concrete identity/date contradiction
No source content establishing the claimed facility or town/event date
Generic media alone without a usable identity/date context; this does not block a clear trusted-source text report
rules: A clear trusted-source report qualifies as verified reporting after matching the relevant assertion, facility and date; list membership is not permission to invent details absent from the report.
No fixed source-count, photograph requirement or independent corroboration requirement.
Unknown cause, damage, operation or media authenticity does not block the reported basic incident.
Keep later corrections and revocations with dates and links; do not silently erase historical reports.

Actual source extraction/matching and exact-version gate provenance remain required, without an additional independent truth-check. Sol remains stopped under the current model override; queued candidates are not silently imported.
Russian-origin reopening/running assertions stay unverified claims and do not alone turn a closed facility into verified operating.
Flags mark a documented assertion origin, not nationality guessed from facility location or the publisher domain.
No incident recorded does not prove never attacked or operating. A hit does not establish outage; explicit dated operational reporting determines operating status.
Reopening needs explicit dated reporting; never infer it from silence or a repair forecast.
Supernova remains an accepted discovery/media source; source-linked matching media and the existing media route remain available.
